payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sum over i=0..k of C(n,i)*D(i) where D(i) is number of derangements of i items, computed via inclusion-exclusion using factorials.
payload.rationale: Solution directly counts permutations using binomial coefficients and derangements, a combinatorial formula, not DP state transitions. dp_counting_combinatorics fits best as it covers combinatorial counting.
